none: PAS SWYOR-BF0F44: Roman Denarius of mark Antony
contea di ritrovamento: North Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman silver coin: A counterstamped Roman Republican denarius of Mark Antony dating from 32-31 BC, struck by a travelling mint. The reverse depicts a legionary eagle between two standards and the legend LEG for Legion, with the idientifing number missing (it started either X or V).
